intent: Type to filter one value, including a list the parent loads asynchronously.
useWhen: A long list the person searches by typing
Options that arrive after a query (async)
One value, with keyboard navigation through the suggestions
doNotUseWhen: A short fixed list in a field menu — use Select
Tags the person types — use TagInput

value.note: Controlled. Empty string is nothing selected.

onQueryChange.note: When set, options are not filtered locally. Parent replaces options as the query changes.

allowCustomValue.note: Enter commits the typed text when nothing is highlighted.

requirements: Escape closes only this panel, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Input is role=combobox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant
Suggestions are role=listbox and each row is role=option with aria-selected
Arrow keys, Home, and End move the active option. Enter selects it. Escape closes and returns focus to the input
Must have a Field label or ariaLabel

doNot: Do not use a native select or datalist
Do not invent ComboboxInput, ComboboxList, or ComboboxItem
snippet: <Field label="City" htmlFor="city"><Combobox id="city" placeholder="Search cities" options={cities} onQueryChange={loadCities} /></Field>
